description.value: Built in 2012, the Best Western Williams Lake Hotel is a modern full-service hotel situated on Broadway Avenue South in the heart of BC's Cariboo Region. It is a branded franchise property offering consistent amenities and a complimentary continental breakfast, making it a reliable overnight stop for cyclists passing through Williams Lake. The Cariboo Region is a major hub on central BC touring routes connecting the Interior to the coast.
